assumptions.choice: Used n_estimators=100 and random_state=42 for RandomForestClassifier.
assumptions.reason: The spec does not define random forest hyperparameters; fixing n_estimators and random_state ensures deterministic execution traces.

assumptions.choice: Training samples use bar offsets i from max(-(len(self)-2), -200) up to -1 inclusive.
assumptions.reason: At bar t (offset 0), the target close[t+1] > close[t] is unknown for the current bar. The latest completed sample with known label is at offset i = -1 (label close[0] > close[-1]). Features at sample i use RSI2[i] and return at i.
